summary: 1-2-Switch entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: 1-2-Switch
entries.definitive_edition: Original Nintendo Switch release with original Joy-Con controllers

emulation.notes: Motion, HD Rumble, and IR features require original hardware/controllers.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Switch hardware with original Joy-Con controllers

primary.version: Original Switch release with original Joy-Con controllers
primary.why: 1-2-Switch is built around Joy-Con motion, HD Rumble, and IR Motion Camera behavior, so native Switch hardware and original Joy-Con controllers are the fidelity route. Switch 2 compatibility exists, but IR-camera minigames require a wirelessly connected original right Joy-Con.
primary.how_to_play: Use Nintendo Switch hardware with original Joy-Con controllers. Record hardware model, controller type, player count, minigame set, room/camera setup, HD Rumble/IR behavior, and any Switch 2 compatibility caveats.

secondary.exclusive_content: Current compatibility route with Joy-Con 2 caveats
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if original Switch hardware is unavailable, and connect original Joy-Con where IR camera features are needed.
secondary.why: Original Switch/Joy-Con is the intended control route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original hardware route with Joy-Con features.
all_releases.reason: primary: required for intended physical party interactions.

all_releases.fidelity: Supported compatibility route, but Joy-Con 2 lacks the original right Joy-Con IR Motion Camera.
all_releases.reason: secondary: current hardware compatibility, not a separate edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Switch 2 compatibility exists, but some original-controller features require original Joy-Con hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Everybody 1-2-Switch! is a separate sequel, not a replacement.
